ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers UI Mod[/h1]
Radial inventory and HUD overhaul for Stationeers (procedural Unity UGUI radials + ImGui HUD). Toolbelt, tool, bag radials, SmartStow+, visor HUD, equipment keys. Client-side optional mod. [h3]POC integrated as Unity mod base[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
Stationeers UI Mod WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
Stationeers UI Mod — Radials for tools/bags, SmartStow+, two-hand visor HUD. Replaces hotbar friction with modern interaction while keeping physical inventory rules.

Ported from BepInEx proof-of-concept into Unity mod project. Radials are now drawn with a fully procedural Unity UGUI renderer (code-built canvas + runtime mesh wedges).
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 0.9.2.0 EXPERIMENTAL — THEMES THAT TRAVEL + THE RADIAL/CURSOR POLISH:[/h3] [list] [*] THE CURSOR NO LONGER FLICKERS IN RADIALS: the arrow pointer strobing while a radial was open is fixed at the root — the "walk/jump/jetpack while a wheel is up" feature was hiding and re-showing the cursor every physics frame. It now only touches the cursor on the exact frames you actually press jump or jetpack [*] MIDDLE-MOUSE ONLY CLOSES A RADIAL: tapping MMB over an item while a radial is open used to select that item — now it just closes the wheel (and dumps any chips you were sorting to the ground, as before) [*] PER-PROFILE THEMES: your HUD colours, glass/glow effects and the radial palette now travel WITH the saved profile — switch profiles and the whole look changes together. Shipped with two curated themes, [b]Stationeers Blue[/b] and [b]Pure HUD[/b] (the old themes are kept in an "Old Themes" folder you can still load) [*] PROJECTED-LENS THEMING: moodlet warning words, per-element colours, icon toggles, optional scan-lines and a carried-item tint — the HUD reads like one coherent projected display [*] DRAG FROM HANDS / 1-6 INTO ANY WINDOW: dragging an item out of a hand box or a 1-6 equipment box into the Universal Inventory or a pinned bag now lands every time (a fast flick-drop used to miss and drop at your feet) [*] VANILLA PLACEMENT BOX WHEN DRAGGING FROM A RADIAL: dragging a chip/item from a radial toward a locker, charger or device slot now shows the game's own coloured placement box (green place/swap, yellow merge, blue insert, red refused) [*] GREYED RADIAL ITEMS ARE STILL DRAGGABLE: with both hands full, a greyed item won't jump into your hand on click — but you can still drag it out as an icon onto the world, a bag or a slot [*] SMART STOW (G) WORKS WITH A RADIAL OPEN: hold the belt wheel, press G, and a belt tool stows to the belt (with the "went in here" flash) — the wedge updates in place [*] EQUIPMENT DAMAGE BARS: a worn item taking damage shows a thin health bar under its icon (green -> yellow -> red), exactly like the vanilla inventory, tinted by the game's OWN damage gradient; the body damage-doll matches it [*] Fixes: splitting a stack to the ground no longer spawns the items inside you (they're placed and launched clear, no self-damage); a suit-power moodlet could get stuck lit in the borrowed status strip — fixed [/list] [h3]Version 0.9.1.1 EXPERIMENTAL — STABILITY, DRAG POLISH + SIZE KNOBS:[/h3] [list] [*] DRAG ANYTHING, ANYWHERE: drag items freely between the Universal Inventory, pinned bags, your hands, the 1-6 equipment slots and the world — both directions. The carried item now always draws IN FRONT of the windows, and pinned bags finally accept drops (they no longer freeze the item at their edge) [*] MENUS ON TOP: opening the pause menu (Esc), the IC10 logic editor, or Stationpedia now hides the inventory windows so the game's menu is on top — and they come back exactly as they were when you close it [*] SMART STOW respects consumable containers: it will no longer stuff items into a water-bottle bag, a cereal-bar box, a burger/egg box or the game-start supplies package — those are no longer treated as storage (real bags, belts and crates still work; ore still fills mining bags) [*] CURSOR is stable in radials: fixed a flicker of the world-selection highlight when you opened a radial and swept to a wedge with the inventory open, plus a one-frame hitch on open. The "hold to look around in a radial" feature was removed (it was unreliable) — the cursor is simply free while any radial is open [*] MORE F9 SIZE KNOBS (F9 > the inventory > Sizes): the manila tab icon, the Sort button, the window close/X button, and the pinned-window title icon + title text — all adjust live, alongside the existing cell/column/tab-size knobs [*] Fixed pinned bag windows rendering as solid yellow boxes (they're frosted glass again) [*] Stability: fixed a hot-reload issue that could make the cursor lag over a long dev session; a stray per-frame error can no longer flood the log or tank the frame rate [/list] [i]Full version history (0.9.1.0 and earlier) is in CHANGELOG.md, in the mod folder and on GitHub.[/i]
